Anatomy Ballistics — 1.1.0 COMPLETE

Load on iPad:
1. Unzip so you have a folder named AnatomyBallistics.codea
2. Open the Files app → On My iPad → Codea
3. Copy AnatomyBallistics.codea into the Codea folder
4. Open Codea — the project appears on the home screen
5. Tap it → Play (landscape)

CONTROLS
• Drag finger — red semi-opaque aim reticle
• Double-tap — fire .22 LR (3 second cooldown)
• RESET button / R — rebuild body; restart at 40 ft
• NEXT button / N — advance range stage
• AutoAdvance (sidebar) — after impact, step closer

STAGES
1–6  Open air: 40 → 35 → 30 → 25 → 20 → 15 ft
7    House wall: ½″ drywall + pine stud + ½″ drywall

INCLUDED BUFFERS
Main, Vec3, TwentyTwo, Bones, Organs, Stages,
Ballistics, SoftBody, Blood, Anatomy, Camera
